content.value: The heat flow in a rod of length 10 cm of homogeneous material is governed by the partial differential equation $u _ { t } = 4 u _ { x x }$ . The ends of the rod are kept at $0 \%$ and the initial temperature $\begin{array} { r } { u ( x , 0 ) = 5 0 \ s i n \left( \frac { \pi x } { 1 0 } \right) } \end{array}$ . Find the temperature distribution $\boldsymbol { u } ( \boldsymbol { x } , t )$
